website_summary.name: CodeCraft Editor
website_summary.description: The website resembles a sleek, modern code editor with a dark theme, featuring a header, sidebar for file navigation, and a main code editing area.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clean and professional design with a dark theme. The header includes a title "Code Editor" and buttons for "Save" and "Run." The sidebar on the left, labeled "EXPLORER," lists files like "main.py" and "README.md" for navigation. The main area is a code editor with a textarea for typing code, and the interface uses icons and text in a monospace font for a coding-friendly experience. The layout is structured with flexbox, ensuring components are well-spaced and visually appealing.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to navigate files using the sidebar, edit code in the main area, and save or run the code using the buttons in the header. The "Save" button indicates the save status, and the "Run" button likely executes the code. The code editor uses a textarea for input, updating the state as the user types.

functionality_testing.name: README.md File Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the README.md File in the sidebar displays its content in the main editing area.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The "README.md" file is visible in the sidebar.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The main editing area displays the content of "README.md". 7. Next Steps : Click on the "README.md" file in the sidebar to display its content in the main editing area.
procedure: Click on the README.md File in the sidebar.
Verify that the content of "README.md" is displayed in the main editing area.

functionality_testing.name: Run Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Run Button executes the code in the main editing area.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The main editing area contains the code `print("Hello, World!")`.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The code should execute successfully, and the output should be displayed. 7. Next Steps : Click the "Run" button to execute the code.
procedure: Click on the Run Button.
Verify that the output "Hello, World!" is displayed.

functionality_testing.name: Test Save Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Save button successfully saves the current file.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Saved Button : Button for saving the current file
functionality_testing.preconditions: The current file has unsaved changes and the application is in an editable state.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The current file is saved without errors, and any unsaved changes are no longer indicated.
procedure: Step 1 : Perform an edit in the code editor to ensure there are unsaved changes.
Step 2 : Click the 'Save' button and verify that the changes are saved.

functionality_testing.name: Test Sidebar Toggle Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Expand/Collapse button correctly toggles the sidebar visibility.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Expand/Collapse Button : Button to expand or collapse the sidebar
functionality_testing.expected_results: The sidebar collapses when the button is clicked, and expands with another click.
procedure: Step 1 : Click the 'Expand/Collapse' button and verify that the sidebar collapses.
Step 2 : Click the button again and verify that the sidebar expands.

functionality_testing.name: Test Close Tab Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Close Tab button will close the current tab.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Close Tab Button : Button to close the current tab
functionality_testing.preconditions: The tab area contains at least one open file tab.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The selected tab is closed and removed from the tab bar.
procedure: Step 1 : Select a file tab to be the current active tab.
Step 2 : Click the 'Close Tab' button and verify that the tab is closed.

functionality_testing.name: Test Main.py Tab Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the 'main.py' tab can be selected and displays the correct content.

procedure: Step 1 : Click the 'main.py' tab in the tab bar.
Step 2 : Verify that the code editor displays the content of 'main.py'.
